title: HD player body: NightElf female (model, textures, faces, hair, skin colors)
description: Replaces the NightElf female player model (display 56) with a community HD body via private CreatureModelData row 2373, plus CharSections rows for every skin/face/hair/facial-hair/underwear variation.
